verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents global transfers to suppliers, employees and contractors, plus batch transfers to recipients in various countries and currencies. Its FX docs describe interbank or guaranteed conversion rates, which partly addresses cost visibility, but no evidence documents transparent payout fees. missing for 10: explicit documentation of transfer fee disclosure or fee schedules, evidence of payouts over local payment rails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees

citations.quote: Airwallex Transfers allows you to move funds across the globe easily to your suppliers, employees, contractors and/or own bank accounts.
Easily manage multiple transfers to recipients in various countries/regions and in various currencies to multiple beneficiaries for payroll runs and supplier payments.
Get the best possible market rate at the point of conversion or a guaranteed rate with a validity period
Access interbank FX rates and programmatically manage currency risk.
